claims.label: Theorem 2.4
claims.statement_original:
Suppose that $K=K_0$ and $s=s_0$ in (2.1). We have
\[
\mathbb P(\widehat\theta^{\mathrm g}\neq\widehat\theta^{\mathrm{ol}})\leq6\exp\left[-\frac{3n}{40\sigma^2}\left\{c_{\min}-\frac{\sigma^2}{n}\big(27\log(pK_0)+12\big)\right\}\right],
\]
which implies that when $c_{\min}\geq\frac{\sigma^2}{n}\{d_1\log(pK_0)+12\}$ for some universal constant $d_1>27$, $\widehat\theta^{\mathrm g}$ consistently reconstructs $\widehat\theta^{\mathrm{ol}}$, i.e., as $n,p\to\infty$, $\mathcal L_g(\widehat\theta^{\mathrm g};\theta^*)\to0$.

claims.label: Theorem 2.5
claims.statement_original:
Define
\[
r(\mathbf X,\mathbf Z,K_0,s_0):=\frac{\max_{1\leq j\leq p}n^{-1}\|\mathbf X_j\|_2^2}{\min_{\theta^*\in\widetilde\Theta(K_0,s_0)}c_{\min}(\theta^*,\mathbf X,\mathbf Z)}.
\]
For any $K_0\geq1$, $p\geq s_0\geq K_0$ and $\ell>0$, we have
\[
\inf_{\widehat\theta}\sup_{\theta^*\in\Theta_c(K_0,s_0,\ell)}\mathcal L_g(\widehat\theta;\theta^*)\geq1-\frac{2nr(\mathbf X,\mathbf Z,K_0,s_0)\ell+\sigma^2\log2}{\sigma^2\log(\lfloor\frac{K_0+3}{4}\rfloor p)}.
\]
Consequently, if $\inf_{\widehat\theta}\sup_{\theta^*\in\Theta_c(K_0,s_0,\ell)}\mathcal L_g(\widehat\theta;\theta^*)\to0$, as $n,p\to\infty$, one must have that
\[
\ell\geq\frac{\sigma^2\{\log(\lfloor\frac{K_0+3}{4}\rfloor p)-\log2\}}{2nr(\mathbf X,\mathbf Z,K_0,s_0)}.
\]

claims.label: Theorem 3.2
claims.statement_original:
For the sequence $\{\theta_m\}_{m=1}^{\infty}$ generated by Algorithm 2, if $L>l$, then there exists $c\in\mathbb R$, such that for any $M\in\mathbb Z^+$ we have
\[
\min_{m=1,\ldots,M}\|\theta_{m+1}-\theta_m\|_2^2\leq\frac{2(g(\theta_1)-c)}{M(L-l)},
\]
where $g(\theta_m)\downarrow c$ as $m\to\infty$.
